page_title: UNI 1-0 WOL | Union Berlin v Wolfsburg 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Janik Haberer is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin).
87' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) makes a rough challenge and Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul.
85' Today's match ends for Mohamed Amoura who will be replaced by Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg).
85' Substitution. Aster Vranckx makes way for Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg).
79' Steffen Baumgart has decided to substitute Christopher Trimmel and he is replaced by Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin).
79' Steffen Baumgart prepares a substitution. Benedict Hollerbach is replaced by Tim Skarke (Union Berlin).
79' Substitution. Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) has come on for Janik Haberer.
77' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) receives a yellow card.
76' The attendance is 22012.
75' A corner kick by Wolfsburg is thwarted by the well prepared Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin).
75' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Wolfsburg will take a corner.
73' Here's the change. Joakim Maehle leaves the pitch and Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) comes on as a substitute.
72' Wolfsburg take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
66' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
63' 1 - 0 Goal! Leopold Querfeld gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 1:0.
58' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

52' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Frederik Ronnow makes a great save to stop his effort.
51' Wolfsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
50' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+2' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Wolfsburg win a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' The corner from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is cleared away by the defence.
42' Wolfsburg fail to score from a corner as Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) leaps to collect the ball.
38' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marin Ljubicic (Union Berlin) comes onto the pitch so that Andrej Ilic can be given a rest.
36' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.

30' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the left side of the goal, but Kamil Grabara keeps it out.
29' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
26' A pass into the box finds Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Frederik Ronnow denies him.
22' Kamil Grabara stretches to his right and makes a brilliant save! Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the bottom left corner.
15' The resulting corner from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is cleared by the defence.
15' The ball is cleared after Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Good work from Union Berlin as they win a corner.
12' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) sends a cross into the box, but Frederik Ronnow comes off his line to gather the ball.
9' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
8' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
3' A cross from the corner kick arrives close to the penalty spot. Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the left post!
2' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) will deliver the corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
Harm Osmers will referee today's match.
